title: return-and-adopt
objective: Come back after a gap and get a recap; adopt a chat that was already running by memorizing its history.

checks.goal: a chat played before the gap exists to return to

steps.eval: globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.setExtractionSettings({ cadence: 2 }); const s = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSnapshot().extraction.settings; if (!s.enabled || !s.profileId) throw new Error(`extraction not configured after import: ${JSON.stringify(s)}`); return s;

steps.send: We meet outside the guild hall at dawn. Arin is still buckling her armour.
I get close to the job board and start reading the postings.

checks.goal: reopening the chat after a simulated multi-day gap shows the away recap

steps.eval: globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.setExtractionSettings({ enabled: false }); await new Promise((done) => setTimeout(done, 1500)); return globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSnapshot().extraction.settings;

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const id = rt.getSnapshot().storyId; const record = ctx.chatMetadata?.story_orchestrator?.stories?.[id]; if (!record?.extras) throw new Error(`no persisted record for ${id} to back-date: ${JSON.stringify(Object.keys(ctx.chatMetadata?.story_orchestrator?.stories ?? {}))}`); const seeded = new Date(Date.now() - 30 * 3600 * 1000).toISOString(); record.extras.lastSessionAt = seeded; await ctx.saveMetadata?.(); const response = await fetch("/api/chats/group/get", { method: "POST", headers: ctx.getRequestHeaders(), body: JSON.stringify({ id: ctx.chatId }) }); const data = await response.json().catch(() => []); const onDisk = (Array.isArray(data) ? data[0] : null)?.chat_metadata?.story_orchestrator?.stories?.[id]?.extras?.lastSessionAt ?? null; if (onDisk !== seeded) throw new Error(`the gap never reached the chat file, so the recap cannot fire: memory ${seeded}, file ${onDisk}`); return { id, seeded, onDisk };

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const blob = ctx.chatMetadata?.story_orchestrator; const journal = (rt.getSessionJournal?.() ?? []).filter((e) => /recap|world/i.test(e.summary ?? '')).map((e) => e.summary + ' | ' + JSON.stringify(e.detail ?? {})); return { chat: ctx.chatId ?? null, chatLen: ctx.chat?.length ?? null, story: rt.getSnapshot().storyId, pending: !!rt.getAwayRecap(), dialogs: document.querySelectorAll('dialog[open]').length, stories: blob ? Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(blob.stories).map(([k, v]) => [k, v.extras?.lastSessionAt ?? null])) : null, journal };

checks.goal: the recap says where the player is in player copy, then dismisses cleanly. "Where you are" reads the checkpoint's player_name and falls back to "Current scene" (snapshotBuilder.ts, 544975fb; ui-review 2026-09-28 finding 2: raw objectives and author names never reach the player). sun-ruins cp1 has no player_name, so the author name "Investigate the Job Board" must NOT appear

steps.eval: const dialog = document.querySelector('dialog[open]'); if (!dialog) throw new Error('the recap dialog is not open'); const text = (dialog.querySelector('.popup-content') ?? dialog).textContent ?? ''; if (text.includes('Investigate the Job Board')) throw new Error('the recap shows the author checkpoint name instead of player copy'); return { playerCopy: true, excerpt: text.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().slice(0, 160) };

const button = document.querySelector('dialog[open] .popup-button-ok'); if (button) button.click(); await new Promise((done) => setTimeout(done, 500)); return { dismissed: !document.querySelector('dialog[open]') };

checks.goal: mid-chat adoption: memorizing the backlog fills memory from history already in the chat (real model)

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; await rt.runMemorizeBacklog(); const snapshot = rt.getSnapshot(); const entries = snapshot.memory.entries.length; if (!entries) throw new Error(`memorize backlog produced no memory: ${JSON.stringify(snapshot.memory.backfill)}`); return { entries, backfill: snapshot.memory.backfill };

checks.prompt: After the gap, did the recap actually put you back in the story — enough to take your next turn without scrolling up?
checks.anchors: 1 = useless · 3 = reminded me of the checkpoint only · 5 = I knew exactly where I was and what was open

checks.prompt: Adopting an already-running chat: was it clear that the extension had caught up on what happened before?
checks.anchors: 1 = no idea whether it worked · 3 = saw it finish · 5 = obvious, and the story used what it learned

checks.goal: the recap never outlives the chat it describes: a brand-new chat is not blocked by it. The back-date is read back from the chat file before the reload (as J4.2 does; T7 r1 reloaded on an unverified back-date and no recap came), and any dialog left open is closed and asserted gone first, so the recap check cannot pass on J4.2's dialog (T7 r2 did)

steps.eval: const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); for (const dialog of document.querySelectorAll('dialog[open]')) dialog.querySelector('.popup-button-ok, .popup-button-cancel')?.click(); await new Promise((done) => setTimeout(done, 500)); const stale = document.querySelectorAll('dialog[open]').length; if (stale) throw new Error(`${stale} dialog(s) still open before the reload, so the recap check could pass on a stale one`); const blob = ctx.chatMetadata.story_orchestrator; const id = blob?.selectedStoryId; if (!id) throw new Error('no story selected in chat metadata: ' + JSON.stringify(Object.keys(blob ?? {}))); const seeded = new Date(Date.now() - 3 * 24 * 3600 * 1000).toISOString(); blob.stories[id].extras.lastSessionAt = seeded; await ctx.saveMetadata(); const response = await fetch('/api/chats/group/get', { method: 'POST', headers: ctx.getRequestHeaders(), body: JSON.stringify({ id: ctx.chatId }) }); const data = await response.json().catch(() => []); const onDisk = (Array.isArray(data) ? data[0] : null)?.chat_metadata?.story_orchestrator?.stories?.[id]?.extras?.lastSessionAt ?? null; if (onDisk !== seeded) throw new Error(`the gap never reached the chat file, so the recap cannot fire: memory ${seeded}, file ${onDisk}`); return { id, seeded, onDisk };

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const open = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('dialog[open]')).map((d) => (d.textContent || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().slice(0, 120)); if (open.length) throw new Error(`the away recap outlived its chat: ${JSON.stringify(open)}`); if (rt.getAwayRecap()) throw new Error('a recap is still queued for a chat that is gone'); const blob = ctx.chatMetadata.story_orchestrator; return { chatId: ctx.chatId, chatLength: ctx.chat.length, story: rt.getSnapshot().storyId, blobChatId: blob?.chatId ?? null, blobSelected: blob?.selectedStoryId ?? null };
